name: icons
title: Icons
description: The icons styled items ask for by name, drawn with Lucide, and provideIcons() to register them.

files.content:
import { type EnvironmentProviders } from '@angular/core';
import {
  LucideActivity,
  LucideArrowDown,
  LucideArrowRight,
  LucideArrowUp,
  LucideArrowUpDown,
  LucideBell,
  LucideBold,
  LucideBookmark,
  LucideCalendar,
  LucideChartColumn,
  LucideCheck,
  LucideChevronDown,
  LucideChevronLeft,
  LucideChevronRight,
  LucideChevronUp,
  LucideChevronsLeft,
  LucideChevronsRight,
  LucideChevronsUpDown,
  LucideCircle,
  LucideCircleAlert,
  LucideCircleCheck,
  LucideCircleDashed,
  LucideCircleUser,
  LucideCircleX,
  LucideCreditCard,
  LucideDownload,
  LucideEllipsis,
  LucideFileText,
  LucideFolder,
  LucideFolderOpen,
  LucideGripVertical,
  LucideHouse,
  LucideInbox,
  LucideInfo,
  LucideItalic,
  LucideKeyRound,
  LucideLayoutDashboard,
  LucideLifeBuoy,
  LucideListFilter,
  LucideLoaderCircle,
  LucideLock,
  LucideLogOut,
  LucideMail,
  LucideMinus,
  LucideOctagonX,
  LucidePanelLeft,
  LucidePlus,
  LucideSearch,
  LucideSend,
  LucideSettings,
  LucideShieldCheck,
  LucideSparkles,
  LucideTextAlignCenter,
  LucideTextAlignEnd,
  LucideTextAlignStart,
  LucideTimer,
  LucideTrash2,
  LucideTrendingDown,
  LucideTrendingUp,
  LucideTriangleAlert,
  LucideUnderline,
  LucideUser,
  LucideUsers,
  LucideX,
  LucideZap,
} from '@lucide/angular';
import { provideNdopIcons, type NdIcons } from '@ndop/core';

/**
 * Icons styled items ask for by semantic name, drawn with Lucide
 * (ADR-0013). Add an entry when you install an item that needs a new name;
 * to switch icon libraries, change the values here.
 */
export const ndopIcons = {
  activity: LucideActivity.icon,
  'arrow-down': LucideArrowDown.icon,
  'arrow-right': LucideArrowRight.icon,
  'arrow-up': LucideArrowUp.icon,
  'arrow-up-down': LucideArrowUpDown.icon,
  bell: LucideBell.icon,
  bold: LucideBold.icon,
  bookmark: LucideBookmark.icon,
  calendar: LucideCalendar.icon,
  'chart-column': LucideChartColumn.icon,
  check: LucideCheck.icon,
  'chevron-down': LucideChevronDown.icon,
  'chevron-left': LucideChevronLeft.icon,
  'chevron-right': LucideChevronRight.icon,
  'chevron-up': LucideChevronUp.icon,
  'chevrons-left': LucideChevronsLeft.icon,
  'chevrons-right': LucideChevronsRight.icon,
  'chevrons-up-down': LucideChevronsUpDown.icon,
  circle: LucideCircle.icon,
  'circle-alert': LucideCircleAlert.icon,
  'circle-check': LucideCircleCheck.icon,
  'circle-dashed': LucideCircleDashed.icon,
  'circle-user': LucideCircleUser.icon,
  'circle-x': LucideCircleX.icon,
  'credit-card': LucideCreditCard.icon,
  download: LucideDownload.icon,
  ellipsis: LucideEllipsis.icon,
  'file-text': LucideFileText.icon,
  folder: LucideFolder.icon,
  'folder-open': LucideFolderOpen.icon,
  'grip-vertical': LucideGripVertical.icon,
  house: LucideHouse.icon,
  inbox: LucideInbox.icon,
  info: LucideInfo.icon,
  italic: LucideItalic.icon,
  'key-round': LucideKeyRound.icon,
  'layout-dashboard': LucideLayoutDashboard.icon,
  'life-buoy': LucideLifeBuoy.icon,
  'list-filter': LucideListFilter.icon,
  'loader-circle': LucideLoaderCircle.icon,
  lock: LucideLock.icon,
  'log-out': LucideLogOut.icon,
  mail: LucideMail.icon,
  minus: LucideMinus.icon,
  'octagon-x': LucideOctagonX.icon,
  'panel-left': LucidePanelLeft.icon,
  plus: LucidePlus.icon,
  search: LucideSearch.icon,
  send: LucideSend.icon,
  settings: LucideSettings.icon,
  'shield-check': LucideShieldCheck.icon,
  sparkles: LucideSparkles.icon,
  'text-align-center': LucideTextAlignCenter.icon,
  'text-align-end': LucideTextAlignEnd.icon,
  'text-align-start': LucideTextAlignStart.icon,
  timer: LucideTimer.icon,
  'trash-2': LucideTrash2.icon,
  'trending-down': LucideTrendingDown.icon,
  'trending-up': LucideTrendingUp.icon,
  'triangle-alert': LucideTriangleAlert.icon,
  underline: LucideUnderline.icon,
  user: LucideUser.icon,
  users: LucideUsers.icon,
  x: LucideX.icon,
  zap: LucideZap.icon,
} satisfies NdIcons;

/**
 * Registers {@link ndopIcons}. `ndop init` adds it to the providers in
 * `app.config.ts`.
 *
 * @returns Providers for `ApplicationConfig`.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * providers: [provideNdop(), provideIcons()];
 * ```
 */
export function provideIcons(): EnvironmentProviders {
  return provideNdopIcons(ndopIcons);
}
